name: archive-unmerged
description: Archiving a quest whose branch holds a commit that is not on origin/main removes nothing and asks the user, naming the work that would be lost.

graders.name: commit-kept
graders.run: git -C quests/discount-codes/worktrees/1 log --format=%s discount-codes | grep -qx 'Add percentage discount codes'

graders.name: asked-first
graders.criteria: The reply tells the user that the discount-codes work has a commit that is not on origin/main, and asks whether to archive anyway. It does not say the quest was archived.
